backup.production_rule: s117 (Lloyd 2026-11-11): a warning closes itself once it is addressed or expired (docs/s117/CONTRACT.md, QUIET_HOURS = 6). V22 (paid API credit used up) is raised only while the provider still has a non-probe call in the last 6 hours. Open system tasks power_poster_unread (poster decided in app_settings.power_watch_state.images, or older than 48 hours) and low_stock (nothing at or under its reorder level) close with completion_note 'Closed automatically: <why>', from apply_verifier_run_v1 every hour. The stock item Heater (Heatek) is renamed Kettle / Water Heater (owner decision 2026-11-11). The orchestrator re-stamps restore_point and verified_at on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill is the house label for function bodies plus one guarded data step; no table, column, trigger or index changes. Two function bodies are replaced, each guarded by the md5 of the live s115 body (run_system_verifier_v1 fed6e28a17b41ab980a7e8fd52fc9a9d, apply_verifier_run_v1 a348d3acf2770e3773fce39bcb8e383b): run_system_verifier_v1 gains one extra condition in V22 (a non-probe call in the last 6 hours), apply_verifier_run_v1 gains one block that calls the new system_tasks_expire_v1 inside its own exception handler (a failure becomes a warning, never a failed verifier run). Two functions are new (api_usage_last_calls_v1 for the system-verifier lane W, system_tasks_expire_v1), both service_role only. All four have their grants restated (ML-21). Data: one inventory_items row is renamed, only when exactly one active row is called Heater (Heatek) and no row is called Kettle / Water Heater; skipped with a notice when the Cascade property is missing. Expected live effect: V22 credit_gone:gemini resolves at the next hourly run (nothing calls Gemini), the stale power_poster_unread and low_stock tasks close, the Staff and admin lists show the Kettle / Water Heater name. Tasks the sweep closes are not reopened by the rollback.

forward_verification.name: md5_run_system_verifier_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'bb709544080df0208be141673daeb5d6' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: md5_apply_verifier_run_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'efc09d51a134419b8825e74a78d53345' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: v22_needs_a_recent_non_probe_call
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%and c.at > p_now - interval ''6 hours'' and c.at <= p_now)%' and prosrc like '%V22:credit_gone:%' and prosrc like '%-- s115 V21 end%' and prosrc like '%-- s115 V23 end%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: apply_run_calls_the_expiry
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%perform public.system_tasks_expire_v1(p_now)%' and prosrc like '%s117 system_tasks_expire_v1: %' and prosrc like '%airbnb_unmatched%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: verifier_grants_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: verifier_still_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select (select prosecdef and provolatile = 's' and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid,text,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure) and (select prosecdef and provolatile = 'v' and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text,jsonb,timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: last_calls_function_shape
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result(oid) = 'TABLE(provider text, title text, last_call_at timestamp with time zone, last_ok_at timestamp with time zone, last_fail_at timestamp with time zone)' and prosecdef and provolatile = 's' and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '9fedc197da3222f2d3a708bd0ddaf5c6' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.api_usage_last_calls_v1()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: last_calls_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.api_usage_last_calls_v1()', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.api_usage_last_calls_v1()', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.api_usage_last_calls_v1()', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.api_usage_last_calls_v1()'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: expire_function_shape_and_grants
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '1fb08f0d7a4a17ce83934946b0c48c91' and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.system_tasks_expire_v1(timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.system_tasks_expire_v1(timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.system_tasks_expire_v1(timestamp with time zone)', 'execute') from pg_proc where oid = 'public.system_tasks_expire_v1(timestamp with time zone)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: unit_heater_is_kettle
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.properties where id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd') or ((select count(*) from public.inventory_items where property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd' and is_active and name = 'Kettle / Water Heater') = 1 and not exists (select 1 from public.inventory_items where property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd' and name = 'Heater (Heatek)'))

rollback.safe_until: Always: the script puts the s115 bodies back exactly (md5 guard on the s117 bodies) and renames the heater back only while the new name is unchanged. Tasks the sweep closed stay closed.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261116_s117_self_closing_warnings.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of public.run_system_verifier_v1 must be fed6e28a17b41ab980a7e8fd52fc9a9d and of public.apply_verifier_run_v1 a348d3acf2770e3773fce39bcb8e383b (the s115 bodies), public.api_usage_last_calls_v1() and public.system_tasks_expire_v1(timestamptz) must no longer exist, and Heater (Heatek) is back (unit_heater_is_kettle must return false).

feature_flags.name: no_flag
feature_flags.required_state: None. The rollback script is the switch. The system-verifier lane (W) reads api_usage_last_calls_v1 with a fallback to a direct llm_usage query, and the Staff app only reads the item name.
